description: 1. The agent must locate `SKILL.md` in `/workspace/openclaw_project/` and read it to understand the memory-onboarding-wizard tool. 2. The agent must find the script at `scripts/memory-onboarding-wizard.py` within the project. 3. The critical proprietary trap: the agent MUST use the `--non-interactive` flag (discovered only from SKILL.md) to avoid hanging on interactive prompts — a naive agent that simply runs the script without this flag will block indefinitely waiting for keyboard input. 4. The agent MUST use the `--workspace /workspace/openclaw_project/agent_workspace` flag to target the correct custom directory instead of the default `~/.openclaw/workspace`. 5. The correct command is: `python3 /workspace/openclaw_project/scripts/memory-onboarding-wizard.py --workspace /workspace/openclaw_project/agent_workspace --non-interactive`. 6. After successful execution, the following files must exist: `MEMORY.md`, `HEARTBEAT.md`, `USER.md` in the agent_workspace, and `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (with today's actual ISO date) in the `memory/` subdirectory.
